_note: Shown in the app's Settings > Change log, newest first. Add an entry in the same push as every change players will notice, and every significant behind-the-scenes change (start those with 'Behind the scenes:'). Plain words, one line each; no app rebuild needed.

items: Guess Lines: a line you guessed in Solo now fills in your guess on the With Bill Simmons podcast tab, so it is not typed twice. Type over it to change it.
In Ireland the site moved on to next week at midnight, in the middle of Monday Night Football, and the Live tab disappeared. The week now changes at midnight New York time, after the Monday game.
Picks now save 1.5 seconds after your last tap instead of 5, so the line across a game card turns to Pick saved sooner.
Guess Lines knows who you are straight away from the app's Settings, instead of asking who is playing while it loads.
Guess Lines now only shows from the end of Sunday night's game to the end of Monday night's, the time when next week's lines are out but not on the site.
The app's Settings has a Tabs section (app version 1.18): Always show Live and Always show Guess Lines keep those tabs up all week.
The app's Settings has a switch to turn all notifications off (app version 1.18). Your choices of which ones to get are kept for when you turn them back on.
Guess Lines now works in the playoffs, from the wild card round to the Super Bowl.
When a week has no Monday night game (week 18, the divisional round and the conference championships), Guess Lines stays up all Monday.

New tab: Guess the Lines, after History. Guess each game's spread before you see it. Solo scores you against the real line. With Bill Simmons podcast plays the week's episode on the page so you can guess along with the show.
Choose who you are under Guessing as before you start. Every week starts fresh, and the week dropdown takes you back to earlier weeks.

Behind the scenes: picks are now saved to and read from a Cloudflare database instead of the Google Sheet, after an 11-day trial where the two matched exactly. Saving and loading should be quicker and more reliable. The sheet is still kept up to date as a backup.
Fixed: Game Details showed a dash under Opened for the Sunday and Monday night games, because their lines are posted a few minutes after the rest of the week's.
History: each column now shows win %, record and net wins (wins minus losses) stacked in one cell, so the table fits a phone without scrolling sideways.

History > Lifetime has an All Seasons / Since Expansion (2023) switch, and a Net Wins by Season chart: everyone's running net, season by season, for ATS, Blazin' 5 and Straight Up. On a computer, Win %, Record and Net each sort the table.
The Net Wins by Season chart has a button for each picker above it: tap to take someone off the chart and the season table, tap again to put them back.
The app's Settings has a Time zone choice (app version 1.17). Kickoff times and the times on the line charts show in the zone you pick. Eastern stays the default.
The spread chart in Game Details marks when you made your pick and the line you took. The "Picked at" note on the game card is gone.
Fixed: a big line move could push the Blazin' 5 star off the edge of a game card.
The Live tab's standings table fades under a spinner until everyone's latest picks have loaded, so it no longer shows old records for a few seconds.
Game Details: the Back button closes the popup instead of leaving the page or the app, and team records are back in the header.
The game list no longer blinks and redraws several times as it loads.
Fixed: History's Blazin' 5 By Spread table could be sorted only once.

New Game Details popup: tap the day on a game card's header. It has tabs for Betting (splits, the line since it opened, TV and weather), Matchup (records against the spread, each team's last five, head to head), Players (injuries and season leaders) and Picks (everyone's pick on the game, and your record with each team).
Line charts: tap Spread or Total in Game Details to see how the line moved through the week.
Lines now update from DraftKings every 15 minutes.
Betting splits: tap a game card to see where the public's bets and money are going.
The app's Settings can show weather in °F or °C.
Fixed: a pick made right before closing the app could stay on your phone and not reach the group until you opened it again.
Insights has a 0-5 Blazin' 5 Weeks card next to the 5-0 one.
Fixed: automatic notifications stopped when ESPN began turning away the server's requests, so the Thursday pick reminder didn't go out. They're back.
Pick reminders now still go out on time if the scores service is down for a while.
Fixed: if the picks sheet had a hiccup, a pick reminder could have told everyone they had every game left to pick. Now it waits and tries again.
Fixed: live scores could stop updating if the first load failed, and switching tabs during a game could make the page fetch scores twice as often.
Records tables and Patterns now weigh sample size: a 5-0 record ranks above 3-0-2, and a single 1-0 no longer tops the list.
Thursday pick reminders name the game and the line, and there's a last-chance reminder 30 minutes before the weekend games.
Tapping a Blazin' 5 results notification opens that week's results.
Patterns show each picker's best and worst record only, and add "in <team> games" records.
Fixed: a live game could show "End Qundefined".
Fixed: a game's line could change after kickoff. Picks are now graded at the line at kickoff.
A pick reminder held overnight by quiet hours is checked again before it shows, so you won't be reminded about picks you've already made.
Lock confirmations say whose picks are being locked.
Each card shows when its pick is saving.
Fixed: picks made early in the week could erase the week.
The Blazin' 5 results notification shows your own result.
App Settings follows the site's light/dark setting.
Phone layout fixes: tabs share the full width, records rows fit the screen, and the header buttons stay round.
History: choose a From/To season range on Lifetime.
The trend chart on phones shows a few weeks at a time. Swipe or use the arrows to move.
Fixed: scores and schedules stopped loading after ESPN changed what browsers can fetch.
Weekly Recap card removed.
Notifications: choose which kinds you get, set quiet hours, and turn on spoiler-free results.
Automatic Blazin' 5 results and pick reminders.
Live tab: switch between Season to Date and This Week.
History opens on Lifetime.
The NFL Picks Android app launched, with group notifications.
Fixed: removing a line pick now removes its Blazin' 5 star too.
Fixed: a tied game is graded as a straight-up push.
Coming back to the site after a while loads everyone's latest picks.
A locked pick shows the line it was locked at.
Fixed: picks made just before switching picker or week could be lost.
New Winnings card: what a flat bet on every pick would have made, at -110.
New 5-0 Blazin' 5 Weeks card, counted across every season.
Standings and History can show one week at a time.
Lines refresh every 3 hours on game days.
Year Chg is filled in, and Last 3-Wk shows a dash until three weeks have been played.
A pick'em is no longer mixed up with a line that hasn't loaded.
New Live tab: the week's Blazin' 5 games with live scores, and the standings as they stand right now.
Cowherd's Blazin' 5 is entered every week and scored like everyone else's.
Every pick is graded at its own line, locked or not.
